sky.qualification: Arrokoth's sky orientation for its camera; the shared universe draws the visible sky.
sky.sceneRegistrationChain: galactic -> ICRF (J2000 constants) -> body-fixed (IAU pole and prime meridian at the epoch) -> ecliptic presentation frame

provenance.source: JPL Horizons fixed 2026-09-03 epoch. Revised pole from the bundled Porter paper Table 2. Its PDS XML gives an inconsistent earlier pole; the paper pole is used with arbitrary meridian and no precision spin-phase claim.
provenance.qualification: Computed Arrokoth Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose.
